purpose: Present an action as completed or regrettable.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
て-form + しまう; spoken てしまう → ちゃう, でしまう → じゃう.
I unfortunately left my wallet behind.
Let us finish reading all of it today.
I ate the last piece of bread.
formation: て-form + しまう; spoken てしまう → ちゃう, でしまう → じゃう.
restrictions: Regret depends on context; completion can be neutral or intentional.
mistake: Do not assume しまう always means an accident.
